cases.notes: Uses the direct graph() command path because the wrapper key map does not expose the dedicated GRAPH key.

cases.notes: CalcEngine does not expose a distinct table() parser primitive, so this locks the deterministic stepped-sequence workflow that currently serves as the automatable table-generation analogue.
